standard_prerequisites.name: Trees of split pairs and valid nodes
standard_prerequisites.statement: A tree attached to a condition is a binary tree whose nodes are labelled by split pairs extending the condition, with the left and right successors extending the two components respectively; a node is valid when along the left branches above it the ascending components lie inside U and along the right branches the descending components lie inside V; the author's own definition is retained at source lines 1169-1183.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the objects of the counted lemma, namely the tree, its labels and the maximality that the construction must enforce.

standard_prerequisites.name: Satisfaction of a pair of Sigma^0_1 formulas
standard_prerequisites.statement: A node labelled by a split pair satisfies a pair of Sigma^0_1 formulas when the first formula holds of the ascending component at the rank of the node and the second holds of the descending component at the number of ones in the node, and a tree satisfies the pair when every node does; retained at source lines 1186-1192.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the property that the increasing sequence of trees must preserve at every stage, and it is what makes the limit tree satisfy the pair.

core_obligations: Build the tree as the limit of an increasing sequence of Y-computable trees, all satisfying the given pair of formulas, so that the limit also satisfies it (source line 1199).
Start with the empty tree at stage zero, which satisfies the pair vacuously (source line 1201).

Stage successor: if there are a split pair with both components of length at most the stage, a node of the current tree and a side such that adjoining the corresponding successor with that label still yields a tree satisfying the pair, then adjoin it, choosing the smallest such split pair in order to enforce the maximality of the limit (source line 1203).

If no such witness exists at a stage, leave the tree unchanged and pass to the next stage, so that the sequence is increasing and its limit is a tree satisfying the pair and maximal with that property (source lines 1203-1204).

proof_roadmap.step: Announce the increasing sequence whose limit is the wanted tree and start with the empty tree.
At each successor stage adjoin one node with the smallest admissible label, and take the limit.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:sads-wf-exists-maximal-tree（源 1194-1196 行，证明 1198-1204 行）：任给一对 Σ⁰₁(Y) 公式与一个条件，都存在满足该对公式的极大 (σ,τ)-树。关键操作不是例行核验：作者把树写成 Y-可计算递增序列的极限（1199 行），并在每个后继步只添加一个结点——同时要求「标签为不超过当前步长的 split pair 且加入后仍满足公式」，还刻意**取最小的可选 split pair**来强制极限的极大性（1203 行）；极大性不是构造的副产品而是靠这一步的选择规则保证的，若换选择规则极限就可能不是极大。难点在于用可计算逼近同时维持「满足公式」与「极大」两条性质；原文位置在证明的 1199 行与 1203 行。
